name: sendthis-mcp

tools.name: send_files
tools.description: Upload files or folders from this computer to the user's SendThis account and get back a share link anyone can use to download them. Folders are sent whole with their structure; hidden files inside them are skipped. Returns the link when the upload finishes. An upload still running after about 45 seconds keeps going in the background: the link comes back right away and works once the upload completes, and upload_status reports its progress. If this computer isn't connected to SendThis yet, nothing is uploaded and the result says how the user approves the connection; call send_files again after they have.

paths.description: Files and/or folders to send. Absolute paths are safest; ~ is expanded. Folders are sent whole.

title.description: Title the recipient sees. Defaults to the file's name, or "<n> files"; set one when sending a folder.

message.description: Optional note shown with the files on the download page.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link expires. Omit for the account's default; longer than the plan allows is shortened to its maximum.

keepForever.description: Keep the link until it is deleted instead of letting it expire (Plus and Pro). Overrides expiresInDays.

recipients.description: Email addresses or SendThis usernames to send the link to once the upload completes. Each gets an email with the title, message and link (a username gets it in their SendThis inbox). Only use addresses the user gave you.

password.description: A password people must enter to open the files (Plus and Pro).

allowComments.description: Let people with the link comment on the files.

tools.name: upload_status
tools.description: Check an upload send_files started in this session: progress while it runs, the share link once it completes, or why it failed.

tools.name: list_transfers
tools.description: List the user's most recent transfers on SendThis, newest first: title, share link, size, file count, when each was created and expires, and its transfer ID for download_files. Sent transfers by default; kind "received" lists what was sent to the user, including uploads to their file requests. Uploads still in progress appear once complete.

kind.description: "sent" (default) is what the user sent; "received" is what was sent to them, including uploads to their file requests.

limit.description: How many to list, newest first (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: download_files
tools.description: Download a transfer's files to this computer: one of the user's own transfers by its ID (sent, or uploaded to their file request), or any SendThis share link. Folder structure is kept, and existing files are never overwritten. A download still running after about 45 seconds keeps going in the background, and download_status reports its progress.

transfer.description: A transfer ID from list_transfers, or a SendThis share link (https://sendthis.com/d/…).

folder.description: Folder to save the files in, created if missing. Defaults to a folder named after the transfer in ~/Downloads. Files already there are never overwritten: a new one with the same name gets "-2", "-3"….

password.description: The share link's password, if it has one.

tools.name: download_status
tools.description: Check a download download_files started in this session: progress, where the files went, or why it failed.

transfer.description: The transfer ID or link given to download_files.

tools.name: create_file_request
tools.description: Create a SendThis file request: a link the user shares so other people can upload files to them. What they upload appears under list_transfers with kind "received", and download_files saves it here.

title.description: What the files are for, shown to the people uploading.

description.description: Instructions shown on the upload page.

password.description: A password uploaders must enter (Plus and Pro).

maxUploads.description: Stop accepting uploads after this many.

tools.name: list_file_requests
tools.description: List the user's SendThis file requests, newest first: title, upload link, whether it is open, and how many uploads it has had.

limit.description: How many to list, newest first (1-50, default 10).

instructions: Sends files from this computer through the user's SendThis account and returns share links, downloads transfers and share links to this computer, and creates file requests that other people upload files to. The first call asks the user to approve this computer in their browser: relay the link and code from the result, wait until they say they have approved it, then call the tool again.
